data.title: speculative verify uses wrong logits offset for prefill batches
data.detail: verify_draft_tokens_logits compared draft j against logits offset j*vocab (position j) instead of (input_len-1+j)*vocab (position after the prompt). Correct for decode batches (input_len==1) but wrong for prefill batches (first speculative step of a new request, multi-token prompt): correct drafts were compared against input-token predictions and rejected, corrupting the output distribution. Bonus-token path had the same off-by-(L-1). Reproduced with a next-token-predicting model (accepted_counts [0] instead of [2]); fixed + regression test.

verify.rs: draft offsets = (input_len-1+j)*vocab, bonus offset = (input_len-1+accepted)*vocab; regression test verifier_prefill_accepts_drafts_at_position_after_prompt (fails pre-fix, passes post-fix).

data.title: radix-tree matched_tokens overcounts when walking past a complete node
data.detail: longest_prefix_match updated matched_len on every matched child but matched_blocks only on complete nodes. data.title: husky-rs fail-fast on missing prek is documented expected behavior (issue closed)
data.detail: Re-analysis: husky-rs README documents "hooks configure on cargo build/test; if prek is unavailable ... the build fails". Fail-fast is a deliberate contract; NO_HUSKY_HOOKS is the documented opt-out. vllm-lite violated the contract by declaring the dev-dep without prek on CI (now fixed with NO_HUSKY_HOOKS=1). Upstream issue #20 closed as not-a-bug. Also reproduced locally: any prek failure (e.g. unwritable prek.log) hard-fails the build, consistent with the contract.

Pending upstream fix (issue #20) that would make prek-missing a warning instead of an error.
